x: Our Canadian friend Page scored a double by winning the 100 and 220 yds. In the former he was chased home by the Fire Services champion Rowe and in the 220 our own Dumbrill was 2nd and Rowe 3rd.
Long Jump: 1 Negus (Bels.), 2 Parker (W.M.S.), 3 George (Bels.). High Jump: 1 Negus (Bels.), 2 Rowe (W.M.S.), 3 Parker (W.M.S.). Weight: 1 Murby (W.M.S.), 2 Eastern (W.M.S.), 3 Fleming (Bels.).
There being no Mile race, Len Herbert ran in the 2 Miles event, and after a fine tussle with Tommy Rowe of Herne Hill, Len ran home a good winner in 9 mins. 33.6 secs.
McKenzie was second, while Syd Jarlett and Bob Wise were second and third in the 440 yards. Charlie Smart turned out for us in the 1 mile and did well to finish third to Rowe and J.

Hewson out---Rowe out---Salvat and Ranjit Bhatia out; what a start! and then Bruce Tulloh, after a tremendous fight, was also eliminated. But saddest of all we saw the slender, loping figure of Gordon Pirie----the only man to stop the incessant "RA!RA!RA!
